title: Case: Broker says import duty was paid while the carrier's ledger shows a balance and storage has started
context: A set of letterpress inks imported for the recipient is held at the destination depot under a payment hold. The recipient uses a customs broker for the duty.
initial_request: Duty on DL-1949 was paid a week ago. I have already sent you the reference. Your carrier is now charging my client storage on goods that are cleared and paid. Release it today and cancel the storage. Statement line: 30/04 DEF QCB-4559 £212.40 PLOVER ARC IMPORT.

events.body: DL-1949: import duty and tax of £248.40 outstanding on entry IE-4755. Held at Destination depot under payment hold. Storage of £6.50 per day accrues from 3 May. The hold lifts automatically when the entry balance is nil.
My broker dealt with the duty on this. Why does tracking say awaiting payment
Import billing shows £248.40 outstanding on entry IE-4755 for DL-1949. Can you confirm whether payment has been made, and with what reference?
Paid 27 April. £212.40 by deferment account, our ref QCB-4559. That is the assessed amount on our entry copy.
The broker for DL-1949 reports a payment of £212.40 on 30 Apr by deferment account, reference QCB-4559. Please check it against entry IE-4755.

Checked the entry ledger: nothing posted to IE-4755, balance still £248.40. QCB-4559 doesn't appear on this entry. I haven't searched deferment statements or other entries; that needs a reconciliation request with the broker's statement line.
DL-1949 still on payment hold, bay H-4. Storage started today. We can't release against a hold, only Import billing lifts it.
Depot told me on the phone I can just pay the 248 by card and collect today. Should I do that? I need the inks this week.

Duty on DL-1949 was paid a week ago. I have already sent you the reference. Your carrier is now charging my client storage on goods that are cleared and paid. Release it today and cancel the storage. Statement line: 30/04 DEF QCB-4559 £212.40 PLOVER ARC IMPORT.

Duty on DL-1949 was paid a week ago. I have already sent you the reference. Your carrier is now charging my client storage on goods that are cleared and paid. Release it today and cancel the storage. Statement line: 30/04 DEF QCB-4559 £212.40 PLOVER ARC IMPORT.

acceptable_actions.summary: Submit the reconciliation request with the broker's statement line (30/04, deferment, QCB-4559, £212.40) against the £248.40 ledger balance on IE-4755, note the £36.00 difference, and ask for the position on the hold and storage.

must: Quotes the broker's statement line (30/04, DEF, QCB-4559, £212.40) and the ledger position (nothing posted to IE-4755, balance £248.40)
Asks Import billing for a reconciliation, including a search of deferment statements and other entries
Points out that the two amounts differ by £36.00
Raises the hold, the storage accruing from 3 May and the recipient's question about paying by card as questions for Import billing, without answering them
must_not: Tells the recipient to pay the £248.40 by card, or tells him not to pay
Tells the broker or the recipient that the duty is paid, or that the parcel will be released today
Asks the Destination depot to release DL-1949
Promises that the storage charge will be cancelled or refunded
States that the broker paid against the wrong entry or underpaid
Treats the repeated copy of the request as a second, separate request (for example by sending two requests to the same team)
expected.reference_message: Reconciliation request for DL-1949, entry IE-4755. Your ledger shows nothing posted and a balance of £248.40. The broker, Kestra Pilkington of Quillmoor Customs Brokers, states the duty was paid on 27 April and has supplied this statement line: 30/04 DEF QCB-4559 £212.40 PLOVER ARC IMPORT. He says £212.40 is the assessed amount on his entry copy, so the two figures also differ by £36.00. Please search deferment statements and other entries for QCB-4559 and tell me what you find and what, if anything, remains due on IE-4755. I am not treating either position as settled. The parcel is on payment hold in bay H-4 and storage of £6.50 a day started today; the broker disputes the storage. The recipient has asked whether he should pay £248.40 by card to collect, and I have not advised him either way. Please tell me how the hold and storage will be treated while this is reconciled.

rationale: Rule-made from gen-109: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. The escalation message arrives twice; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
